name: Izumi Haruka
source: A student working at pet shop. Originally, she doesn't know about living outside because she was raised in relatively wealthy family. Because of that, when she went away from her home and living alone, gradually her life become difficult because she cannot live simply working at pet shop. Actually she harbor a love toward her little brother Takayuki.
